title: 再翻一次
text:
这里的东西更多，也更危险。

要搜三次：前两次安全，第三次一定会惊动什么。遭遇了就地打一场，打赢了对方身上的东西归你。

打输了不扣体力，但这个点就不能再翻了。

texts.en:
More to find here, and more danger.

Three searches. The first two are safe; the third will wake something, guaranteed. If you run into something, you fight it on the spot. Win, and whatever it carries is yours.

Lose, and it costs no Vitality, but this spot can't be searched again.
